imageNote: Rainy motorway seen from the driver's seat: several vehicles ahead, a white van on the left and a truck on the right, wet road with raindrops on the windshield. The photo is contextual only and does not change the answer.
en: Most road accidents are caused by human mistakes such as inattention, speed not adapted to the conditions or too short a following distance, rather than by vehicle faults or the state of the road, so the statement is right. Rain and dense traffic like in the picture only increase the demands on the driver, which is why the rules insist on prudent conduct and safe distances.
pt: A maioria dos acidentes de viação resulta de falhas do condutor, como falta de atenção, velocidade inadequada às condições ou distância de segurança insuficiente, e não de avarias do veículo ou do estado da via, pelo que a afirmação está certa. A chuva e o trânsito intenso, como na imagem, apenas exigem mais prudência ao condutor.
ru: Большинство дорожно-транспортных происшествий происходит из-за ошибок водителя — невнимательности, скорости, не соответствующей условиям, или слишком малой дистанции, — а не из-за неисправностей автомобиля или состояния дороги, поэтому утверждение верно. Дождь и плотное движение, как на фото, лишь требуют от водителя большей осторожности.
